comparison.objective: Re-sort six bottles across crowded shelf levels without disturbing neighbors, not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated horizontal extraction, staging, insertion, and multi-object stability management; no tool engagement or calibration.
comparison.success_condition: All bottles on color-matched shelves, none tilted, fallen, or displaced unsafely, and two-second released stability versus two safe impacts.
comparison.reason: Crowded multi-object sorting is materially different from iterative adjustment.
